description: StockPilot warehouse admin app with plugin installation, supplier import mapping, report previews, redirects, and static dashboard widgets.

vulnerabilities.description: User-controlled report preference data reaches dynamic JavaScript execution through eval.
User-controlled plugin package input is interpolated into a shell command executed with child_process.spawn.
A URL search parameter is assigned to a dynamically-created script element source.
The application creates and serves the admin API over a plaintext HTTP server.
JSON.stringify is used in an attempted sanitization flow before evaluating generated JavaScript code.
The plugin installation endpoint performs expensive package installation work without rate limiting or throttling.
A user-controlled continuation URL is passed directly to res.redirect.
A route parameter is used to build a protocol-relative redirect target.
User-controlled nested property names are written directly into an object profile.
The API reflects permissive cross-origin access while allowing credentialed browser requests.
A nested quantified regular expression is evaluated against user-controlled stock code input.
A dynamically constructed nested quantified regular expression is evaluated against user-controlled stock code input.
